scope: Pure host library validation: shapes, budgets, readback validation and shared job settings. CLI process, image decoding and filesystem input contracts use CPU integration tests. Miri does not certify UI, JIT, GPU or transitive native libraries.
linux_limit: The P0 Slint/tiny-xlib eager constructor was removed from the headless core dependency graph. Canonical Darwin Miri remains required; no new Linux Miri qualification is assumed from the graph change.
reopen: Any changed or new production source or dependency resolution requires review. New OS-specific authored code invalidates cross-host coverage unless separately qualified. Required CI must execute canonical macOS Miri; a Linux local all result cannot substitute.
